user_query: I am planning a trip to Europe and I need to convert my currency to Euros. Can you provide me with the current exchange rate from USD to EUR? Additionally, I would like to know the price of Bitcoin in Euros to consider investing. Also, recommend some tourist attractions in Paris for my itinerary. Thank you!

TaskList.description: Fetch the current exchange rate from USD to EUR to assist with currency conversion for the trip.
Retrieve the current price of Bitcoin in Euros to evaluate investment options.
Provide a list of recommended tourist attractions in Paris for itinerary planning.
